novelty_flags.label: Theorem 3 (CGD certified upper)
novelty_flags.one_line: Its risk upper bound and the d-regular sqrt(d)/n lower benchmark are a direct conjunction of the published Conflict Graph Design variance theorem and the published DTE minimax bounds, so it should be demoted to an already-known calibration lemma rather than sold as a new frontier half.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 gap; technical_internal_limitation
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal says design-adaptive Le Cam/posterior-risk calibration against unrestricted nonlinear estimators cannot be replaced by citation, but KandirosHarshawSavje2026 already develops network-specific, design-adaptive mixture lower bounds for the unrestricted joint design-estimator minimax game; only calibration to the new exact-regular reduction is open.

soundness_flags.label: def:modified-ht; thm:cgd-certified-upper; thm:frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: Gamma_n permits estimators only of (z,Y(z)), but the displayed modified HT estimator requires E^*_{i,k}, hence the auxiliary desired variables W_i; these events are not recoverable from z, so the claimed estimator is not presently an element of Gamma_n.

soundness_flags.label: def:mis-game
soundness_flags.one_line: The supremum condition n^{-1} sum_i u_{i,k}^2 <= 1 leaves k unbound; state the two constraints explicitly for k=0,1 to define the game value.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 2 and 4; Proposition 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Unique Games and NP not contained in BPP are accepted as external standard complexity premises, not claims proved by this project.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The computational frontier and numerical-value hardness are conditional on UGC and NP not contained in BPP.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2-3, especially lines 66-76 and 132-138; p. 21, Section 5.1; p. 24, Conjecture 2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines minimax risk over all designs and estimators, develops network-specific design-adaptive mixture lower bounds, gives d-regular DTE bounds sqrt(d+1)/n lesssim R lesssim (d+1)/n, and leaves d^(1/2-epsilon) approximation hardness as Conjecture 2.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 16, definition of the modified HT estimator and text immediately below it; p. 73, Theorem 4.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The modified HT estimator explicitly requires the auxiliary desired-exposure variables U_i, and Theorem 4.1 bounds its variance by 12.5 lambda(H)/n times the two relevant second moments.
For independent set the paper chooses q=Theta(1/log d) and beta=Theta(log d/d), obtaining Theta(d/log^2 d) hardness on graphs of maximum degree at most d.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 3, Theorems 1-2; p. 10, randomized two-sided-error reduction conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states bounded-degree Max-2-CSP hardness under UGC and, separately, randomized-reduction hardness unless NP=BPP, with explicit randomized-decider bookkeeping.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Proceedings landing page; theorem text unavailable through the inspected primary landing page
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The primary proceedings record verifies the paper, authors, venue, pages, and its induced/semi-induced-matching scope; the exact Theorem 5.9 formulation remains routed to source verification before relying on its stated regular-double-cover detail.

source_verification_receipts.version: JASA 103(482), 2008 author manuscript of the published article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article uses potential outcomes under interference and randomized experimental designs to define direct and related causal effects and unbiased estimators, supporting the finite-population design-based framing.

The article proposes independent-set-based designs for direct-treatment-effect estimation to disentangle peer effects and evaluates designs through simulations, supporting its role as an applied consumer rather than a universal-risk comparator.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Expand Gamma_n to recorded-design-coin estimators gamma(z,W,Y(z)), or formally derandomize the CGD procedure before defining kappa; then restate the certificate event on that admissible procedure space.

Replace the generic claim that all-rule Le Cam calibration is absent with the narrower, accurate novelty claim: a donor-promise, exact-regular, DTE-realizable value separation that instantiates the published all-rule machinery.

Move the CGD upper theorem to an explicitly already-known calibration proposition, cite its two source ingredients, and concentrate the flagship theorem on the new exact-regular two-sided reduction and its certified hardness consequence.
Specify the q=2 constraint in the MIS game as two named layerwise inequalities and state the exact R_2(G)=mathfrak R_2(H_DTE(G)) bridge that the reduction invokes.

recommended_next_step: Revise this angle: repair the estimator information set and game definition, accurately delimit the published design-adaptive lower-bound machinery, and recast the CGD upper as calibration before advancing the exact-regular two-sided reduction.
